[Law and order](http://search.records.nsw.gov.au/functions/1) is a broad group of functions aimed at regulating and protecting society. It encompasses the preparation, enactment and enforcement of statutes, law reform, the maintenance of civil order, detection of crime, apprehension of criminals and the civil and criminal court systems. The punishment and rehabilitation of offenders is a significant element of Law and Order, including the provision of secure corrective institutions and the supervision of non custodial sentences. 

Law and order encompasses making justice available to all through such measures as legal aid, the provision of legal advice, and supporting the victims of crime. It includes institutions such as parliamentary inquiries, royal commissions, and inquiries into public sector activities and corruption. Law and Order also involves protecting the physical safety of all members of society through organisations providing fire and emergency services.

results.name: 3-16683-the-horsley-drive-upgrade--mimosa-road-to-elizabeth-street--wetherill-park--review-of-enviro
results.notes: The Horsley Drive (Main Road 609) provides east-west access through the Fairfield Local Government Area between Wallgrove Road and the Hume Highway. Currently a two-lane single carriageway exists in this section of the Horsley Drive and the arrangement has sufficient capacity for current and projected traffic flows. The Horsley Drive is frequently used by heavy haulage trucks and is the principal access into the Smithfield/Wetherill Park industrial area. The Roads and Traffic Authority (RTA) proposes to upgrade The Horsley Drive at Wetherill Park from the current two-lane arrangement to an ultimate six-lane dual carriageway between Mimosa Road and Elizabeth Street. This review of environmental factors (REF) assesses the environmental effects associated with an interim upgrade to four-lane dual carriageway as the first stage of the ultimate six-lane upgrade.
